___style_anchor: Handcrafted stop-motion puppet animation — sculpted matte clay characters, needle-felted wool fleece, miniature tweed tailoring, miniature stone street diorama with glowing lantern, and shallow macro photography.

visual_mood.primary_feeling: Warm affectionate companionship, cozy sunset peace, and folk diorama charm

visual_mood.narrative_subtext: The elderly shepherd resting in the evening street, smiling with fond affection as he pats the head of his loyal lead sheep beside a warm glowing wall lantern

micro_features: Warm glowing amber light emanating from the glass-paned wall lantern mounted to the stone wall on the right
Individual loop-pile curly wool knots visible on the companion sheep's fleece under directional side-light
Hand-sculpted cobblestone road texture with irregular rounded stones and dusty clay crevices
Textured tweed weave on the shepherd's blazer showing herringbone wool fibers and horn button
A rustic vertical plank wooden doorway with iron latch details set into the stone facade on the far right
Golden-orange sunset sky gradient glowing in the narrow alley gap between village buildings
Soft optical bokeh rendering the background sheep and distant village cottages into dreamy pastel shapes

negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, realistic human photograph, CGI 3D digital model, glossy plastic skin, modern lighting, fluorescent lights, asphalt road, modern clothing, digital video game artifacts
reconstruction_priority: Warm lantern illumination and golden sunset dual-lighting — AI frequently flattens lighting into uniform ambient or misses the localized lantern glow
Tactile miniature tweed jacket and curly wool fleece textures — AI tends to hallucinate smooth synthetic fabrics or procedural noise
Sculpted matte clay facial features with warm gentle smile — AI often distorts stylized puppet faces into distorted photorealistic human wrinkles
Organic cobblestone diorama street with physical macro depth of field — AI frequently draws flat repeating tile textures
